arg.name: bringup
arg.description: The robot's persistent stack: a launch file with a use_sim_time arg

arg.name: record
arg.description: The rosbag2 directory to record to

arg.name: real_time_factor
arg.description: Simulated seconds per wall-clock second; 0 runs as fast as the host allows

arg.name: keep_pace
arg.description: End the episode when it falls behind its real-time factor instead of slowing down

arg.name: viewer_port
arg.description: The port to serve Lichtblick on; 0 picks a free one

executable.cmd: drawcall-robotics sim $(var scene) --real-time-factor $(var real_time_factor) $(if $(var keep_pace) --keep-pace --no-keep-pace) --record $(var record) $(if $(var record_all) --record-all --no-record-all) $(if $(var viewer) --viewer --no-viewer) --viewer-port $(var viewer_port) --bridge-port $(var bridge_port)
